steps.label: Discover
steps.sub: client broadcasts: "is a DHCP server out there?"

steps.label: Offer
steps.sub: a server proposes an address + configuration

steps.label: Request
steps.sub: client broadcasts which offer it's accepting

code:
Client                              DHCP Server
  |-- DHCPDISCOVER (broadcast) -->     |
  |<------- DHCPOFFER -------------     |
  |-- DHCPREQUEST (broadcast) ---->     |
  |<------- DHCPACK ----------------     |
caption: No IP yet, so no unicast — every server on the segment has to see the Request.

code:
IP address       192.168.1.142
Subnet mask       255.255.255.0
Default gateway   192.168.1.1
DNS server(s)     192.168.1.1, 8.8.8.8
Lease time        86400 seconds (24h)
caption: A DHCP offer is a full configuration bundle, not just an address.
